name: Holiday Inn Express Orange Beach-On The Beach
description: Holiday Inn Express Orange Beach-On The Beach is an exceptional beachfront hotel providing views of the gulf from the comfort of your room. White sandy beaches, warm breezes, and pristine blue waters of the Gulf of Mexico are just outside our front door. Our convenient location off Perdido Beach Blvd puts you within driving distance of amazing dining and entertainment. Our Orange Beach, Alabama hotel is on the shores of the Gulf of Mexico - perfect for deep sea fishing, parasailing or wave running. There are countless activities to do during your stay at our Orange Beach hotel.
